# Hi, I'm <span class="gradient_text">Nhan</span>.

Hello! My name is Nhan, and I am an Assistant Professor of Accounting at IESEG. I hold a PhD in Business and Finance - Accounting track - from UC3M and was a visiting scholar at UNC-Chapel Hill in the spring of 2024.

My research interests include <span style="color: #EE6A24;">*corporate disclosure and auditing*</span>, with a particular focus on their economic consequences. My current agenda examines on how corporate reporting and auditing navigate untraditional and emerging issues related to <span style="color: #EE6A24;">*technology and regulatory development*</span> to meet public demand for high-quality information. To support that, I apply cutting-edge data science techniques, such as <span style="color: #EE6A24;">*machine learning*</span> and <span style="color: #EE6A24;">*generative AI*</span>, to explore <span style="color: #EE6A24;">*novel databases*</span> and quantify <span style="color: #EE6A24;">*new research concepts*</span>.


I'm ready to teach financial accounting and auditing courses, leveraging my professional and <span class="gradient_text"><strong><a href="teaching/index.html" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: none;">teaching background</a></strong></span>. I'm also keen to lead research and data-oriented courses, supervise student theses, and mentor PhD students as needed.
